title: commit_mixed can leave workspace file written if DB step fails (cross-medium half-write)
promise: config-commit: 跨介质（文件 + 数据库）写入不是事务，不承诺「错误必无变更」; Andy口径: 边界情况，可为更强一致性加固
actual: SettingsWriter::commit_mixed calls write() (workspace file) before store::replace_all (DB). If DB/validate fails after write(), file change is durable while generation is not advanced and DB unchanged. Call sites: delete_workspace_custom_tool, delete_workspace_mcp_server.

evidence.note: write()?; then mutate + replace_all; generation only after both

repro: 缺注入：在 store::replace_all 失败时观察工作区自定义工具/MCP 文件已删而 DB agents 绑定未剥。非日常写崩；建议加固：DB 成功后再落盘，或失败回滚文件，或 temp+rename。

history.change: Batch 3 from DRAFT-MC-1; node claim already truthful; recommend optional harden
renumbered from ISSUE-013 to avoid cross-agent collision

WP-008 decision A: commit_mixed snapshots workspace file before write; on mutate/validate/DB failure restores snapshot best-effort then returns Err; unit tests commit_mixed_restores_file_when_{db_step,validate}_fails
